title: Scotland scrape past UAE with one wicket & ball left
snippet: Scotland beat United Arab Emirates by one wicket as Jasper Davidson struck the winning boundary with just one ball to spare in a dramatic finish to their Men's Cricket World Cup League 2 Tri-Series match in Dundee.

title: James Gray Told His Wife He Would Get an Award at Locarno. She Reminded Him to Take Out the Trash
snippet: The U.S. auteur also mentioned the Beatles and said, "I have many good films, hopefully, left," as he received the Swiss fest's Career Leopard before an outdoor screening of his 'Paper Tiger.'
